notes.title: Small change - Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
Information added to the objective.

 Banishment and ritual => Book: Banishment and ritual
 Attic key help: I indicate the rooms where to look for a book or document.
 It is specified that the location of objects is random. (In the same area.)

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Bulbs explode less often.
 2 camera animations have been removed.
 2 clues have been added to the code puzzle.
 A clue has been added to the attic puzzle.
 Add a call-to-action icon to open the door to the tomb.
 Sage has been renamed 'Salvia' in all languages to avoid confusion.
 The sprint is unlimited.
 The gears no longer make the demonic skulls appear.


Thank you for your suggestions (Discord, Twitch, Steam), which enabled me to quickly adjust the content for as many people as possible.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content: Change of font for Asian languages.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changes :

 Improved range and power of the UV lamp
 Bulbs are less likely to explode
 The timer before the hunt is paused by pressing the Settings button.
 The crucifix pushes the entity away from the player, disorientates it and slows it down for 8 seconds.
